title: Weighing Ethical Obligations
grammar: Comparing present moral duty (kellene) vs. unfulfilled past obligation (kellett volna)
goal: I can contrast ongoing moral duty (kellene / volna szabad) with past hindsight (kellett volna).
I can articulate dilemmas between autonomy and medical paternalism.
I can use B2 ethical vocabulary to evaluate conduct and conscience.
